Heading 8308 is excluded per EN 83.08 and HQ 954696 because snap hooks with spring catches and swivels possess mechanical fastening functionality beyond simple hooks. By application of GRI 1, the goods fall under heading 3822 as diagnostic reagents on a backing. Subheading 3822.90 covers certified reference materials under Note 2(a) to Chapter 38.
